w: A devotee brought his friend before Swamishri and revealed, "Swami, he has become habituated to betting on cricket matches. " Swamishri: "It is a form of gambling." Devotee:"Swami, he also drinks." Swamishri: "When you have one vice, then many more follow behind it. Do you know that because of gambling the Pandavas lost their kingdom and wife, Draupadi? It is a devastating habit, therefore give it up. You’ll become a lot more happier in life." Swamishri’s words appealed to the young man and he pledged to give it up.

A senior vice-president of a software company in Mumbai came for Swamishri’s darshan. He was terribly shaken by a big theft that had happened a month back in his house. The thieves took away the jewellery, cash and valuables. "Everyone is disturbed and unhappy in the house," a friend explained to Swamishri. Swamishri pacified the vice-president, "There is no benefit in remaining distressed. What has gone has gone. It will not come back. By worrying, your health will get affected. So chant the holy name of God. Don’t worry. Everything is going to go away one day." "But because it is gone that is why I am pained," the gentleman added. Swamishri reinforced him with spiritual understanding, "By believing that ‘I have lost it’ one feels pain. But it was not yours. If you believe this then your grief will disappear." Swamishri blessed the gentleman and redeemed him from his mentally and emotionally paralysed state.

Tonight a senior executive of an industrial house came for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. A month earlier there had been a theft at his home. They had all gone out of town, so the thieves stole his wife's jewellery, cash and whatever was valuable. As a result of the theft, every member of the family was troubled.

Swamishri said, "There is no benefit in being troubled. What has gone has gone. It will not come back. Worrying will affect your health. Chant the name of God. Everything is going to go one day." The executive said, "But one feels sad about what has gone."
Swamishri said, "One feels sad by believing 'what was mine has gone'. If you think 'it was never mine at all', the sadness will go away."
He did dandvat to Swamishri and received his blessings. Coming out, he said, "Now I feel very good. I am very much at peace."

King's Palace At 8.15 am, Swamishri arrived at the palace of the king of Jagannathpuri. He was welcomed at the main gate by the king and led into his living room. The king bowed and reverentially touched the feet of Swamishri. Then he performed pujan of Hrikrishna Maharaj and Swamishri amidst Vedic chantings by the palace Brahmins. The king then explained the history of Jagannathpuri, mandir and its kings.

Jagannath Mandir Thereafter the king and Swamishri went to the Jagannath Mandir. The darshan of the main murtis were closed for 15 days because it is believed that after the smearing of chandan during the summer months, God becomes ill and He therefore takes rest. During this time the devotees do darshan of Bhagwan Jagannath's 10 forms that are installed outside the sanctum doors. The king explained the importance of the other shrines during the pradakshina of the mandir. Swamishri also bathed in the ocean waters sanctified by Nilkanth Varni and chanted the dhun.

Indradumyna Lake Swamishri arrived at the Indradumyna lake where Nilkanth Varni had resided and sanctified the lake. As a memorial to His visit, Swamishri inaugurated a small marble shrine and installed the murtis of Akshar and Purushottam. Then the holy feet of Harikrishna Maharaj were bathed with the sanctified waters of the lake and Swamishri too sprinkled the water on his head.

At 10.30 a.m., Swamishri arrived for the convention of rural devotees from 110 villages around Surat. More than 3,000 devotees were present during the assembly. A drama on 'Sagram Vaghri's Transformation' was performed by the rural youths. Finally Swamishri blessed the devotees.
Yuvak - Yuvati Din (morning) Yuvak - Yuvati Din (evening)

In the morning assembly BAPS youths presented a drama showing how through western influences a satsangi youth’s satsang fades. In conclusion the youths prayed to Swamishri to guide them to remain unflinching in Satsang. Swamishri talked about Hanumanji’s steadfast devotion and allegiance to Shri Ram, Prahlad’s conviction in God and the transformation of Sagram Vaghri.
The Dpy Consul General of Israel in Atlanta, Mr Aviv Ezra, presented a proclamation to Swamishri.

In the evening assembly the Charlotte Yuvak Mandal presented three skits about serving through mind, body and speech. Thereafter Dr Swami explained how one should serve in that manner. The youths then presented incidents and recitations regarding the need for associating with the Satpurush for fostering seva and bhakti. Thereafter Viveksagar Swami further elaborated on the subject. Prior to Swamishri’s blessings an inspiring interview of youths dedicated to Satsang was held.

Brahmswarup Yogiji Maharaj used to say, “Yuvako Maaru Hriday Chhe,” which means “Youths are my heart”. Presently, youths experience the same intimacy with His Divine Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Yuvaks and Yuvatis of the South East region expressed their love and affection for Swamishri today as part of the Yuva Din celebrations.

During Swamishri’s morning walk, yuvaks sang kirtans praising Yogiji Maharaj. When Swamishri entered the Yuva Din morning sabha, yuvaks danced with dhols as saints sang “Anand No Rang Dholo Swami…”. Yuvaks performed a skit illustrating how personal satsang declines in yuvaks. At the conclusion of the skit, the yuvaks asked Swamishri to provide techniques to progress in satsang. Swamishri advised the youth to make satsang the highest priority in their lives, and at the same time avoid kusang. In the end, Swamishri sprayed colors on Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, and saints sprayed the sanctified water on the yuvaks.

In the evening assembly, the Deputy Consul General of Israel to the United States, Mr. Aviv Ezra, presented a proclamation recognizing Swamishri’s efforts to promote non-violence and peace. Saints started singing “Swami Amare Ang …” before Swamishri arrived, and they continued singing until he entered the hall. Swamishri and the devotees were in a very joyous mood. Yuvaks organized a program around three topics: seva, bhakti, and agna-palan. Pujya Doctor Swami described ways to do better seva, and Pujya Viveksagar Swami explained why the bhakti of pragat is more beneficial than paroksh bhakti. Swamishri, during his blessings, elaborated on the three topics presented by the yuvaks during the program and stressed the importance of satsang reading.

From 5 June the evening assemblies were celebrated as Shri Hari day, Gunatit Day, Bhagatji Maharaj Day, Shastriji Maharaj Day and Yogiji Maharaj Day, in which skits, speeches and blessings of Swamishri were the main highlights. Today the evening assembly was in celebration of Swamishri’s 55th anniversary as president of BAPS. In his blessings Swamishri said, “Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on this earth with his abode (Aksharbrahma) and muktas to redeem countless people. Maharaj travelled in the forests and throughout India and arrived in Sorath. After Ramanand Swami passed away he introduced the Swaminarayan mantra and he became known as Swaminarayan85” Then Swamishri talked briefly about the work of Guru Parampara.

Today a youth from Ahmedabad came for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Telling Swamishri what was in his heart, he said, "Bapa! Many times in my life I have received your blessings. Many times you have also done my work for me. Now I am married too. I am settled in every way, but inside I keep feeling that no interest remains. Worldly life keeps feeling empty."

Consoling the youth, Swamishri said, "Now that you have entered worldly life, you have to carry out the responsibility. Slowly take your family life forward. Keep patience. If your mind keeps feeling troubled, your wife will be troubled too, and your family will be troubled. So put your mind into making your family life go well. Do not stay outside it."

Baba Ramdevji Maharaj, who has spread yoga throughout the world, came to meet Pramukh Swami Maharaj today. He has great respect, regard and reverence for Swamishri. That is why, whenever he gets the chance, he makes a point of coming to meet Swamishri.

Today too he sat in Swamishri's presence for about three quarters of an hour. During the conversation, his admiration for Swamishri and the work of the organisation could be seen overflowing again and again. At this time too, speaking about something, he said, "What I am most proud of is the discipline you have established and the character you have built, because with your blessings the whole community of sadhus is able to live a spotless life. This is a source of pride in the world. You have created a tremendous ideal. Because of the ideology you have created, all of us feel proud; otherwise, today, if we wanted to show someone as an ideal, whom would we show?"
Swamishri immediately said, "Bhagwan Swaminarayan has created all these ideals."
"But keeping this discipline alive, as you have done, is also a great work, isn't it!" said Ramdevji Maharaj.
Finally, as he was leaving, he said, "I have the protective armour of your blessings, so nothing will trouble me."

A fax had come from a student in Dhule. In it he had written, "Pratibha Patil, the President of India, came to Dhule. She gave us a meeting in Dhule. We told her, 'We are volunteers of the organisation of Swaminarayan Akshardham in Delhi,' and said, 'Here too there is a very large modern educational complex of the same organisation.' Although she did not have time and so could not come, she was very pleased to hear about Akshardham in Delhi and the hostel." This is what he had written in the fax.
Pleased after reading the fax, Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Akshardham's arrow reaches everywhere." Even as he said this, great pleasure could be seen on Swamishri's face.
